meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 按 Dieter Rams 十项原则逐项给设计打 0–3 分并附证据,判定新建、优化或重做,输出一份可直接用的 /make-plan 提示词;审计结果写入 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录,它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“audit this design”“design review”“critique this design”等关键词,或要求一次应导向计划的批评时触发;常规 UI 代码审查、纯文案修改、尚无产物的设计前构想不走它。

say.note: 先锁定范围,再逐项取证打分

say.text: 这份设计十项原则的单项得分和总分是多少?
判定结果该新建、优化还是重做?给我可复制的 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: Scores a design 0–3 on each of Dieter Rams' ten principles with cited evidence, gives a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and writes a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt plus audit files into DESIGN-IS-<date>/.
howto.when_en: Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "critique this design", or wants a critique that should lead to a plan. Not for routine UI code reviews or pure copy edits.

say_en.note: Locks scope first, then gathers evidence

say_en.text: What's the per-principle score and total for this design?
Is the verdict NEW, REFINE or REDESIGN? Give me the /make-plan prompt
